service.ur: شہریوں کے خاندانی ڈیٹا میں ترمیم

about: Update a citizen's family record, such as adding a wife or a newborn or recording a divorce or a death.
note: Requirements read from the official ICP service page on the checked date. ICP fills the form in from the person's records after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Amend family data (citizens). Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Adding a foreign wife needs an attested marriage certificate, plus a UAE marriage continuity certificate if the marriage is over a year old
A newborn born abroad needs a birth certificate issued by UAE authorities
An unemployed husband needs a Sharia court status declaration when adding a wife
Complete any changes ICP asks for if the application is returned
documents: Marriage certificate, or for a non-citizen wife her birth certificate, latest qualification and marriage contract
Marriage continuity certificate when the contract was issued abroad or is over a year old
Birth, divorce or death certificate, or a marital status certificate, depending on the change
fees: The page lists no fee; the amount is shown at payment
channels: ICP Smart Services website or ICP Smart App (sign in with UAE PASS)
